blockers.description: Official v5.3 document and example bodies and per-file content hashes are not retained.
Generated documentation has not been reproduced from the exact release.
Potential/model files, datasets, trained weights, and executable examples require independent identity and license review.
Exact binary, backend, GPU runtime, build flags, and native execution behavior are not validated by this pack.

limitations: The source license does not establish redistribution rights for example datasets, potential/model files, trained weights, GPU runtimes, or third-party dependencies.
The exact source-tree inventory does not establish a native GPU build, binary behavior, model/data licensing, NEP transferability, transport convergence, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.

losses.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation and example bodies remain external.
The exact v5.3 documentation build and generated navigation/reference surfaces have not been reproduced.
Executable example inputs, datasets, potential/model files, trained weights, and outputs are retained only as path/object metadata and are never executed or deserialized.
GPU backend, build flags, hardware/runtime compatibility, binary identity, and native behavior are not established by source documentation.

subjects.title: Build and identify the exact GPUMD v5.3 executable for the selected NVIDIA or AMD GPU backend.
Invoke GPUMD v5.3 from a closed working directory whose run.in and referenced input identities are recorded.
Interpret GPUMD process state, exit status, output files, and textual diagnostics as separate technical gates.
The v5.3 run.in command stream defines setup, potential, ensemble, run blocks, outputs, and continuation behavior in order.
The v5.3 model.xyz structure contract includes atom count, lattice, periodicity, species/type mapping, coordinates, and units.
Potential selection and model-file identity must match the v5.3 potential command and deployed format.
A v5.3 molecular-dynamics protocol is staged into initialization, equilibration, production, and validation segments.
Ensemble, thermostat/barostat, timestep, temperature, pressure, and coupling choices follow exact v5.3 command semantics.
Thermodynamic and trajectory output commands have v5.3-specific fields, cadence, units, and append/overwrite behavior.
State-file continuation and segmented runs require explicit parent, restart, and output lineage under v5.3 semantics.
Performance benchmarking preserves the scientific model and records backend, hardware, build, problem size, and timing evidence.
The v5.3 Green-Kubo equilibrium-MD route requires heat-current sampling, correlation/integration controls, and replicated uncertainty analysis.
The v5.3 HNEMD route requires a linear-response driving field, heat-current response, direction conventions, and convergence checks.
Two-dimensional normalization and fluid/solid heat-current conventions require explicit v5.3 method and dimensionality handling.
Thermal-conductivity acceptance requires correlation time, production length, size, field-strength, sampling, and replicate evidence.
NEP construction closes train/test data identity, extxyz fields, units, species ordering, reference methods, and split provenance.
NEP v5.3 training configuration records descriptor, network, loss, regularization, batch, generation, seed, and restart semantics.
Restarting NEP training preserves parent model, optimizer/evolution state, data identity, and changed hyperparameters.
NEP validation extends beyond training loss to held-out energy, force, virial, structures, domains, and failure modes.
Deploying a NEP model in GPUMD v5.3 requires exact model identity, supported format, species mapping, units, cutoff, and smoke evidence.
The exact v5.3 examples tree is supporting official workflow material whose executable inputs, data, models, and outputs require separate review.
All official behavior claims are bounded to the GPUMD v5.3 release source snapshot rather than the rolling website.
Source licensing, external model/data licensing, GPU runtime terms, privacy, and execution authorization are separate boundaries.
